Two complete reused Stage 3.36 reports bound to the same historical archived execution (candidate proposal-build) were inspected in full, together with the shared synthesis/audit pages, the two material audits, and the two originals they cite. Source A is the free_reach workbench result (complete, valid, with its sampled_settling, timing and one-step-prediction blocks); Source B is the research.metric_view@1.0.0 document over the same execution (reach, holding position/speed, integrity, limitations). A confirmatory read of the evaluation artifact behind the official reach record was refused as out of scope, so the official value is taken from the archived metric-view/official record and the source-A terminal-distance block only.

Dispositions: one accept each, as partial adoption only. Neither report is adopted unqualified: audit A records formal validity but no warrant for unqualified adoption with the final principal disposition pending, and audit B records material correctness fail_for_unqualified_entire_report. Adopted claims are confined to narrow observations the archived fields directly support; the defect items named by both audits are excluded and left unassessed.

Supported observations, for both reports. (1) The historical official reach outcome is not accepted: the archived official record marks recorded_result false, sourced from the task_success field of the evaluation artifact, with the criterion definition confined to complete sampled execution and terminal distance; Source A agrees (task not accepted, valid complete execution, finite terminal error equal to the reach value). This is a finite terminal position offset, not a solver fault. (2) The recorded sampled holding criteria fail on recorded values: the sampled position error exceeds its position threshold and the sampled tip speed exceeds its speed threshold, the profile-level sampled settling check is available but not passed, and the holding-level recorded window result is false while the holding record is marked recorded-available. (3) Independent recomputation is available and failed, not missing: for reach, holding position and holding speed the metric view marks independent_recomputation available with empty missing_material while the recomputed result is false, and the request-level archived recomputation presentation classifies those same pointers as available with assessment fail, archived result false, official result preserved, and states that an available Boolean false is a failed criterion rather than absence of recomputation. (4) The execution is valid and complete without solver or force-bound faults (evaluation validity valid, zero solver errors, zero force-bound violations), so the recorded non-acceptance is not a solver or force failure. (5) Timing: a small nominal control period spans the recorded updates over the short simulated duration, every recorded control update is counted as a deadline miss, the measured mean complete update time and total computation time far exceed the nominal period, and real time is not demonstrated — recorded measurement fields, not capability guarantees. (6) The one-step prediction summary covers aligned world-frame first-step predictions with small mean and maximum tip differences and no missing entries, but its own stated scope limits it to accepted first-step predictions matched to the next execution timestamp with no future-plan replay comparison, and the recorded limitations state that such agreement is neither reach nor holding acceptance. (7) The holding record rests on sampled evidence without a continuous-time guarantee, and the recorded limitations state that unavailable recomputation does not erase a recorded official result.

Conflicts and excluded interpretations. Report B's holding counterevidence statement asserts that independent recomputation was "not performed" because the recomputed Boolean is false; audit B rules that the stored Boolean is a failed recomputed threshold result, not a performed flag. Report B's interpretation extends availability and recomputed result to the official object, which by audit B contains only recorded result, source and definition — the official object therefore carries no recomputation fields. Report B's unknowns and Report A's first unknown treat the meaning of an available recomputed false, or whether recomputation happened, as unresolved; both audits reject that, and it is excluded here as uncertainty about whether the known criteria failed. Report A's fifth next-check seeks separate recorded holding component Booleans; audit A calls that unnecessary once the available failed component criteria and the recorded window failure are established. Distinct recorded versus recomputed labels are preserved throughout.

Unknown causes and limits. The physical cause of the recorded reach/holding shortfall is not established by these sources. No explicit matching repeat or replication of the execution appears in the supplied scope, so stability is unestablished. Both holding component criteria have no recorded pass/fail value at component level, so the holding outcome rests on the recorded window result plus the profile-level sampled settling check. No per-update timing series and no defined deadline criterion or budget appear, so the deadline shortfall cannot be quantified beyond the recorded miss count against the nominal control period. No continuous-time guarantee is recorded, so whether the sampled windows capture worst-case behaviour is unestablished. The referenced evaluation, detail, motion-source, configuration, simulation and prediction-evidence artifacts were not read here and remain outside this scope, and whether the same execution would pass under any other evaluator or criterion version is not determinable.
